notes.title: PHAIGEX V1.0.4.5 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Enjoying the Holidays, Confiners?

For today's quick update, we are working on how to better communicate PhaigeX's game mechanics with less confusion or misinterpretation from vaguely-worded descriptions. Also, reports from recorded streamers shown some visual UI bugs, and we sure have to fix those!

It's now time to clear things up:

[h2]GAME CHANGES[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]EMP Slow Debuff Mechanic[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/6322f4f6a8aa8d702ad0ff16d32d9920d70e2bd1.jpg[/img]
- [b][EMP Slow] debuff[/b] is the term for inflicting [b][Reduction to Rate of Fire and Movement Speed][/b]
- This basically [b]debilitates the enemies' function[/b], rendering them easy pickings for your weapons
- Applying this debuff in with other sources makes them [b]Stack Additively[/b], slowing down to a halt
- Without stacking, the EMP Slow status eventually [b]weakens out over time until it wears off[/b].
- Remember that the enemy can do the same to you as well with their own disruption tech
[*][b]Buffs to [Debuff] tag Weapons[/b]
- [b][Lightning Fence Lv2][/b] Lightning Arc now inflicts EMP slow to enemy ships as they pass by 
- [b][EMP Bolt Lv1][/b] can now disrupt homing missile guidance on hit
- [b][EMP Bolt Lv5][/b] leaves a small shockwave on hit that can disrupt drones and missiles
- As a visual indicator, disrupted missiles loses their thrust and just floats around
[*][b]SP Tech Descriptions Update[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/153ef4062d1e6aa36ede7f67d4f8c753ab377b2f.jpg[/img]
- To lessen confusion of the way to use the SP Techs, [b][Lv1 text descriptions have been elaborated][/b]
- SP Tech descriptions now tells the way to [b][Gain Tech Meter][/b] and [b][Activate SP Tech][/b]
[/list]
[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Hyperspace Mode:[/b] CRITICAL BUG where having an Allied Leviathan (reward from a limited mission) on Megalith Event without [PhaigeX Cavalry] passive causes the stage to freeze
[*][b]Hyperspace Mode:[/b] Added tooltips for those choices that provide resources + ship modifier
[*][b]Hyperspace Mode:[/b] Fixed events that allows both [b][Defeat Fleet][/b] and [b][Defeat Boss][/b] success events to trigger at the same mission

[list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/b42c80e6e38c99a9bc060254d49ab82053569d4d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/81ef169bee1c589a57816b48c80a194de7a411bb.gif[/img]
We called them "Prime Skins", to depict their peak of development. Simply put, these are the final forms of the original ships. Like the Alter Skins before, a selected unique ability of the ship is modified, potentially changing the ships' play style in a way that surpasses the original. What's cooler about them are the articulated ship parts that move whether by default, or when you use your SP Tech! Unlock them by finishing Hyperspace Mode with your chosen ship.
[/list]

- Increased projectile size

- Increased projectile count

- Does not have an invincible starting period anymore, can be shot down anytime

[*][b]Hyperspace Mode[/b]

- Support Shop: Buyable Ship Modifiers starts appearing upon reaching [b]Full Arsenal, when all weapon & passive slots are filled AND fully upgraded[/b]
- Gravity Well Events: gravity pull activates after UI event text is closed
[*][b]Audio SFX[/b]
- Lower the cap of stacking SFX to avoid breaking eardrums.
[/list]
[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Hyperspace Mode:[/b] Modifier Tutorial should also show when it first appears on rerolls
[*][b]Hyperspace Mode:[/b] In Capture Recon Base event, prevent loading Limited Missions for the next area

notes.title: A PEEK INTO THE UPCOMING HYPERSPACE CAMPAIGN MODE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/9903c1c70b7a0832f84986142ce04e36d72c2bc7.png[/img]
Welcome back, PhaigeX employees.
Rest assured that the people here at Development are working non-stop on an upcoming new game mode, the Hyperspace Campaign!

...but you might be wondering, what is this game mode?


[h2]What Hyperspace Mode is About[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/995e46908ab9fdaaa1bcb06abc1ac22ae4291181.jpg[/img]
In Hyperspace Campaign mode, the player is going to be given the role of a Confiner, to keep the incoming AI threat under control within the vast outer space. It is a roguelike game mode where the Confiner warps into different space sectors, and deal with the events that they encounter on that area, whether good or bad they may be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/47e194500c93a8cadde6db3fadce0542ba50d968.jpg[/img]
The events may vary, not only from the previous Survival, Fleet Assault and Demolition modes, but also new encounters like escort missions, disarming enemy tech, gathering allies, dealing with merchants and resupply stations... and more! We could use some more ideas and suggestions for event encounters, to keep things fresh.

In this game mode, the ships you use will always start on its base stats (customized stats and modifiers are disabled, but skins are allowed to be equipped). The Experience Leveling system is disabled in this mode, so the path of growing stronger lies on the events and their rewards, and the occasional powerup drops from enemies (Power Up drop rates are adjusted too). The choices you make in this campaign will result in consequences down the line, so choose your actions wisely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/b7a3e44f4b5d08aaa2d955d94f8a8e5bf307b45b.jpg[/img]
Once the event objective is resolved, you can immediately warp out and proceed to the next sector. In the event of a defeat, it is still possible to warp back to the last progress point, provided that the player has Warp Cores to spend.


[h2]Game Mode Progress, and Possible Plans[/h2]

Currently, the Hyperspace Campaign mode is still under development. The events are functional, with more bugs here and there. As for the end game encounters, they're still up on the table.

We are still on the drawing board about how to navigate the campaign from this direction, so please keep an eye out for updates! We want to hear your encounter ideas too!

Towards a brighter future,

The PhaigeX MegaCorp.

notes.title: ROADMAP: DEMOLITION MODE IS NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
PhaigeX Employees, we have found the enemy A.I. stronghold!

Now it is finally time to take the fight to them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/b4007185419c37c030cfc5d57a41c8d7aed7d272.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Game Mode: Demolition[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/efe56daa10b33a3a129eab8916fbea9c9d3bb454.jpg[/img]
[b]Demolition Mode[/b] drops the player in the middle of the enemy territory, and is tasked to destroy key structures to deal a heavy blow on the A.I. incursion progress. The endeavor will not be a walk in the park (look at the 5-star difficulty), as the place is filled with fortified strongholds that has the defensive firepower to keep unsuspecting intruders away. Enter this game mode with a fully-upgraded ship for a better chance of survivng, not that we are stopping the ones who want the challenge of using base stat ships here.

To succeed in this mission, a central structure called a [b]Megalith[/b] needs to be taken down. It is protected by a powerful barrier which is impervious to attacks, so disabling the barrier is the priority before the actual demolition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/c8cdbe22d65f1bc7739195f3fb19181395561c93.jpg[/img]
Four (4) [b]Energy Pylons[/b] are placed in megastructures connected to the Megalith, supplying power to support the barrier. Destroy all of them, and the barrier will weaken. Keep in mind that the enemy forces will do just about anything to stop you, and they have the home advantage to impede your progress with armed structures, ability to call in enemy drones and ships, and troublesome incursion events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/70e94e359ab9eb1182104ec29babd6503b2f115d.jpg[/img]
When you go back and face down the Megalith, be ready for a tough fight. Its segmented modules are already tough to deal with as they are, but keep watch of the central warp it is trying to open. Also, try to avoid reaching 100% incursion, because that would open a whole new can of worms for you.


[h2]Demolition Mode Clear Reward: Alter Skins![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/83220ffdf638402599ed9471a695850c862ec3bb.jpg[/img]
Your efforts will be rewarded once you clear Demolition Mode with the ship of your choice. It will unlock a new skin for the ship you used, but it is not just any normal skin. Besides making alterations to the ship's appearance and attack visuals... it also adds modifications to one of the ship's unique abilities, offering a new dimension of play using the same ship!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/de2f57ea0d3d9771dcfffbb374b670abf2f6fb7b.jpg[/img]
You can see the modifications made by the skin on the modified abilities' description (in purple text) on the support shop, or on the pause menu if you have the unique ability equipped.

[h2]Gameplay Changes and Bug Fixes[/h2]
With the new update (and progress from the Beta branch), ships, weapons and passives have undergone changes to mesh well with Demolition Mode. Some equipment will do bonus damage against structures, so take a second look at the description of some of these.

While most bugs have been mostly taken care of since the introduction of Demolition in the beta branch, please report back to us for any suspicious or game-breaking behavior that comes up with this update. Our people here at Development are always open for your feedback and suggestions.

[h2]Roadmap Progress[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/13a666a951f240ac30b9ce1b59258c5d9684347a.png[/img]
We finally got Demolition Mode out of the roadmap. As for what's next, the Management deliberated on some matters, and have come to the decision that instead of adding another ship banner, a new set of common power ups will be introduced to increase build variety. In addition, it is planned to look back to the currently implemented Weapons/Passives/SP Tech and give them the update they deserve, whether that be improved visuals, stat buffs or possible synergies with other abilities. Look forward to those developments in future announcements.

Towards a brighter future (It is finally within our reach!),

The PhaigeX MegaCorp.

notes.title: ROADMAP: THE PIONEER SHIP BANNER IS NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Rejoice, honored employees of PhaigeX MegaCorp!

The wait is over! Reinforcements have arrived in the form of 5 new playable ships and 2 new support crafts, to strengthen our forces in the never-ending war against the A.I. menace. Discover new ways to utilize each ship's arsenal, and come up with more unique play styles!

No need to worry about accessibility! Just one game update away, and the banner is available to you all. As per usual, please use the hard-earned Warp Cores you have been stashing from your prior missions to take a chance in obtaining them.

Before we move on, the people at Engineering and Development still need to introduce the final members of the Pioneer ship banner. You can read up on the previously completed ships from the earlier news threads.

[h2]PHGX-010 "ORACLE"[/h2]
In the continuing quest of understanding how the rogue A.I. takes over decrepit space vessels, a sort of "counter-hacking measure" has been developed in its early stages. Tests proved that the technology is still not good enough to wrestle complete control away from the A.I., but a small step in the right direction can still be made into a disrupting force that can sow chaos in the tightest of enemy formations. Hence, the Oracle ship is born, with state-of-the-art equipment designed to be a maximum annoyance for the enemies as much as possible.

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/ded317482f27c8e52a4a6da5f48f76b723687c58.gif[/img][/h3]

Built for electronic warfare, Its [b]Firewall Buster[/b] SP Tech overloads drone systems to self-destruct, while on more sophisticated enemy ships systems, converting them to become ally units. Converted enemy ships will shoot at their own kind, and will take damage for you should you use them as shields. Be careful though, since the Oracle consumes Tech Meter to maintain control over converted units.

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/f14198254452ec50ed74d7701542be97b22f0ba6.gif[/img][/h3]

And how to gain that meter? It's starting unique passive, [b]ECM Package[/b] constantly emits from the Oracle, providing a wide-range disrupting field that repels drones, and slows down enemy ships to a halt. Keeping enemy ships within the ECM field fuels the meter needed to bust their operating systems!

As a complementary ability for the electronic warfare equipment, the [b]Recon Support[/b] optional passive provides bonuses that affect drop rates and improving support craft usage. Sometimes, doing a great support job can help last through tough challenges ahead.

[h2]SUPPORT ARMS:
SPS-003 "GARUDA" and SPS-004 "SCARAB"[/h2]
The Support Crafts this time around were both developed with one thing in mind: "Complete Firepower Control". These so-called "Support Arms" warps in and provides backup fire as usual, but what makes them special is the Support Actions they offer.

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/50547f22d832276b6425aa181fb1b8befb1f5939.jpg[/img][/h3]

The Support Action [b]Armed Override[/b] allows the player ship to dock and combine with the Support Arms, transforming the Support Craft, and activating its expanded arsenal for you to use. Lay down excessive firepower against all that stand in your way!

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/5c049966328ef4161bf3cd1c00bbb48aad154302.jpg[/img][/h3]

To differentiate the two Support Arms, the Garuda lays down the thunder with concentrated bullet burst and explosive missiles, and has a Support Action to block energy weapons. The Scarab on the other hand, utilizes a spread of beams and fusion blasts, with a Support Action that repels kinetic weapons.

[h2]NEW CUSTOMIZATION FEATURE: SHIP SKINS![/h2]

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/05a04424ba3105de31f0da917e0bc2a897b52737.jpg[/img][/h3]

Tired of the same old ship look? Spice things up with equippable skins obtained from the Transportal! Currently, 3 new skins are available for each player ship (including the new ones) that are color swaps in nature. Keep an eye out on future updates for possible redesigned skins!

[h2]Workspace Improvement:
Game View Zoomed Out by 25%[/h2]
We have receive suggestions to expand the field of view for the gameplay, and now we gladly oblige! Hope this will help have a good look at the area, and react better to enemy movements.

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/6a7fc1830abb8010f9e0a97531c026cf06a0cc25.png[/img][/h3]

Finally, another roadmap milestone has been completed. We would like to keep a watchful eye for any bugs and issues this update will bring for the meantime, so feel free to try out the game and keep in touch with us with your feedback. We appreciate your continuous support with PhaigeX's development.


Towards a brighter future,

The PhaigeX MegaCorp.

[h2]PHGX-010 "ORACLE"[/h2]
In the continuing quest of understanding how the rogue A.I. takes over decrepit space vessels, a sort of "counter-hacking measure" has been developed in its early stages. Tests proved that the technology is still not good enough to wrestle complete control away from the A.I., but a small step in the right direction can still be made into a disrupting force that can sow chaos in the tightest of enemy formations. Hence, the Oracle ship is born, with state-of-the-art equipment designed to be a maximum annoyance for the enemies as much as possible.

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/ded317482f27c8e52a4a6da5f48f76b723687c58.gif[/img][/h3]

Built for electronic warfare, Its [b]Firewall Buster[/b] SP Tech overloads drone systems to self-destruct, while on more sophisticated enemy ships systems, converting them to become ally units. Converted enemy ships will shoot at their own kind, and will take damage for you should you use them as shields. Be careful though, since the Oracle consumes Tech Meter to maintain control over converted units.

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/f14198254452ec50ed74d7701542be97b22f0ba6.gif[/img][/h3]

And how to gain that meter? It's starting unique passive, [b]ECM Package[/b] constantly emits from the Oracle, providing a wide-range disrupting field that repels drones, and slows down enemy ships to a halt. Keeping enemy ships within the ECM field fuels the meter needed to bust their operating systems!

As a complementary ability for the electronic warfare equipment, the [b]Recon Support[/b] optional passive provides bonuses that affect drop rates and improving support craft usage. Sometimes, doing a great support job can help last through tough challenges ahead.

[h2]SUPPORT ARMS:
SPS-003 "GARUDA" and SPS-004 "SCARAB"[/h2]
The Support Crafts this time around were both developed with one thing in mind: "Complete Firepower Control". These so-called "Support Arms" warps in and provides backup fire as usual, but what makes them special is the Support Actions they offer.

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/50547f22d832276b6425aa181fb1b8befb1f5939.jpg[/img][/h3]

The Support Action [b]Armed Override[/b] allows the player ship to dock and combine with the Support Arms, transforming the Support Craft, and activating its expanded arsenal for you to use. Lay down excessive firepower against all that stand in your way!

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/5c049966328ef4161bf3cd1c00bbb48aad154302.jpg[/img][/h3]

To differentiate the two Support Arms, the Garuda lays down the thunder with concentrated bullet burst and explosive missiles, and has a Support Action to block energy weapons. The Scarab on the other hand, utilizes a spread of beams and fusion blasts, with a Support Action that repels kinetic weapons.

[h2]NEW CUSTOMIZATION FEATURE: SHIP SKINS![/h2]

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/05a04424ba3105de31f0da917e0bc2a897b52737.jpg[/img][/h3]

Tired of the same old ship look? Spice things up with equippable skins obtained from the Transportal! Currently, 3 new skins are available for each player ship (including the new ones) that are color swaps in nature. Keep an eye out on future updates for possible redesigned skins!

[h2]Workspace Improvement:
Game View Zoomed Out by 25%[/h2]
We have receive suggestions to expand the field of view for the gameplay, and now we gladly oblige! Hope this will help have a good look at the area, and react better to enemy movements.

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/6a7fc1830abb8010f9e0a97531c026cf06a0cc25.png[/img][/h3]

Finally, another roadmap milestone has been completed. We would like to keep a watchful eye for any bugs and issues this update will bring for the meantime, so feel free to try out the game and keep in touch with us with your feedback. We appreciate your continuous support with PhaigeX's development.

notes.title: ROADMAP: NEW SHIP BANNER DEVELOPMENT UPDATE
notes.content:
Greetings, PhaigeX employees!

We are bringing new updates about the current Roadmap Milestone: The second Player Ship and Support Craft Banner, which we will now call "PIONEER", following the first "ORIGIN" banner. Another two ships have been successfully developed and customized for combat, that's now four out of the five player ship target. Only one more ship... and 2 Support Crafts remaining.

The people at Engineering and Development got to inject more of their personal quirks into the design and mechanics of these two units, probably as a result of brainstorming while drunk, but they were able to make the concepts work into interesting weapons of mass destruction. Let's see what they have in store for us this time.

[h2]PHGX-008 "RAVE-N"[/h2]
Someone seem to have had been high on night parties recently, and constructed such a lightshow of a ship. This seemingly fragile-looking ship has the equipment to emit powerful Radiation Waves, or Raves as the young ones call it, to burn and melt down enemy hardware. Too much radiation is bad after all... for the opposition, that is.

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/57653304f71f8bea5843f35f5629fe0c6148034d.gif[/img][/h3]

The [b]Rave Gamma Blaster[/b] SP Tech is very simple to use, a straightforward "turn-on, point and shoot" cone of intense radiation can even make the toughest ships explode from inside just with seconds of exposure. However, maintaining it active as a weapon rapidly drains the Tech Meter, so it should be used smartly. Gotta conserve energy.

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/f0a087c8173922b1618fda00175074d08f50fb09.gif[/img][/h3]

Apparently, there's more to the use of Raves other than just direct exposure. The [b]Diffraction Prism[/b] unique weapon serves as a conduit for spreading the Raves even further when the Rave Gamma Blaster is fired at it. Not only that, on higher levels, the prism can also absorb certain energy emission weapons to scatter around as lasers. The spectacle when both happens is quite the sight.

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/c8d14b1cb2b59e53501b1b89593cc66e005051d4.gif[/img][/h3]

To further strengthen the equipment, the optional unique passive [b]Unstable Overdrive[/b], delves deep on the varying Rave wavelengths (Ravelengths?) and making Raves more powerful and colorful at the same time. It also synergizes with increasing output size for energy emission weapons, making the lightshows even bigger.

[h2]PHGX-009 "SLEDGENAUT"[/h2]
Going onto the opposite spectrum from the previous ship, the concept of this unit doesn't get any simpler: "Just ram the enemies, head-on.". As a result, a highly-armored, yet surprisingly fast ship has been conceptualized. For the issues that surfaced from the ship being "too heavy to move fast", the solution also became its weapon: "Explosive Momentum". Both its SP Tech and Unique Weapon causes the ship to boost forward, gaining enough momentum to ram enemies. This ship is built to become an unstoppable force that breaks through anything that stands in its way.

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/444805d3eb2e79987ea53e9ac4773fe81a948de5.gif[/img][/h3]

The built-in [b]Strike Anchor[/b] SP Tech does the "striking" part well against drones and missiles, but the real value comes from the "anchor" part hooking onto enemy ships. Grab one with the anchor, and in the next moment, the ship winds itself towards the hooked enemy at ramming speed.

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/9dc244243ad2436734b5a58db640b654adf6e8f9.gif[/img][/h3]

Weaponizing the ship's massive thrusters, the [b]Explosive Boost[/b] unique weapon acts both as a close-range explosive blast and a tool to propel the ship forward at ramming speeds. Use this to compensate for the natural slow speed this unit has, for evasion or for offense.

Lastly, a ramming ship deserves to have a good armor protection, so the [b]Composite Armor[/b] unique passive grants the ship a chance to ignore incoming damage, while improving efficiency on other passives that activate when the ship gets hit. Keep on charging forward!

...and that end our small peek into these new ships. Almost done here, just finish one more ship and two Support Crafts, and this update will be released before September ends. We are excited to have you handle these babies soon, the wait won't be any longer!

Towards a brighter future,

The PhaigeX MegaCorp.

notes.title: ROADMAP: PROGRESS ON NEW SHIP DEVELOPMENT
notes.content:
To all the PhaigeX employees, we at Management are delivering the news in regards to the current Roadmap Progress Milestone: Player Ship and Support Banner#2.

The busy people here at Development have completed two out of the targeted five player ship count. Conceptualizing ship designs proved to be quite the rewarding undertaking, and they have given their word that piloting these beauties will provide quite the refreshing and enjoyable experience, not to mention the firepower they bring once upgraded to the limit. For now, we are excited to introduce these two newly-developed ships you will get a hold of once the the Roadmap Milestone is finished.

[h2]PHGX-006 "PLUVIA"[/h2]
Showering the opposition with massive firepower is the Pluvia, which is a word for "rain" if you look up the definition. What this unit excels at is guided homing weaponry, as reflected by its starting equipment.

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/77ceab90c198562214c9810fb6ae6325a50b4573.gif[/img][/h3]

Its SP Tech is the [b]Homing Laser[/b], which seems very straightforward. Use all the remaining tech meter to fire multiple lasers at once, automatically seeking enemies to destroy. The lasers might not be powerful individually, but it makes up with the sheer amount fired. Just keep an eye on the tech meter levels to keep firing in huge bursts!

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/eae6ac916f0aeeb4c0b63d211811ea74417e4a0f.gif[/img][/h3]

The "guided" homing weaponry part is handled by its unique passive equipment, the [b]T.A.G System[/b], short for "Target-Anchored Guidance". Holding the SP Tech will show a detection circle, tagging all enemy ships and ship sectors within the circle's range. Releasing the SP Tech will still fire the Homing Lasers, but this time the focus of the lasers are the units that were tagged! Upgrading this passive will allow guided control over homing weapons as well, so the potential for focused firepower is high.

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/53d207e152bd98bb04d94740148335f8049e77e8.gif[/img][/h3]

Its optional unique weapon, the [b]Photon Shower[/b], might look like it's just scattering energy mines that damages enemies on hit, and seems unwieldy. The key to using this properly is to have an appropriately-upgraded T.A.G System. Just from looking at the demonstration, the names for these are very much well-earned.

[h2]PHGX-007 "ARBALEST"[/h2]
Next on the line is an attempt to create a "transformable" ship that can shift roles as the situation demands. Trying to incorporate multiple roles into a ship will cause some pros and cons to its performance and handling, but the Arbalest has both of its forms' specifications balanced to the roles it need to serve. As a bonus, all its unique equipment transforms with it.

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/c4672a8cd4fec77bef42d9c2bf5a04629e8b228e.gif[/img][/h3]

The SP Tech allows the ship to "[b]Mode Shift[/b]" between two forms:
[list]
[*]The default [b]Agile Mode[/b], boasting good movement speed at the expense of slow turning speed. Tech meter fills up in this form over time.
[*][b]Breach Mode[/b], used for long-range sniping, slows the ship's movement speed and fire rate but grants increased damage. In this form, there is zero tech meter gain, even from passive and mod bonuses. The view even goes a bit forward to show what's beyond the screen.
[/list]
Transforming together with the ship, is its unique weapon, the [b]Burst Shell[/b]:
[list]
[*]In [b]Agile Mode[/b], it rapid-fires flak shots that explode to an area on hit or a set distance. This is useful for intercepting small objects like drones and missiles.
[*]In [b]Breach Mode[/b], it shoots a single large shot that burst into smaller bullets on hit, perfect for damaging larger units.
[/list]
[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/4c35d44dc85717c449c625c6e528c962db44dd0d.gif[/img][/h3]

Lastly, its unique passive, [b]Mode Expansion[/b], add more features to both of the ship's forms:
[list]
[*][b]Breach Mode[/b] gains directional shields that protect the ship while sniping. Damages to the shields drains the tech meter.
[*][b]Agile Mode[/b] scatter bombs with all the remaining tech meter as form of both offense (bombing run through enemies) and defense (screens out chasing enemies and missiles)
[/list]
...and those were just TWO ships, but there is a lot of uniqueness and personality imbued to these to suit specific play styles. Here's hoping the remaining three ships, and two additional Support Crafts, can also have their unique specifications that will breathe new life to the never-ending fight towards eradicating the AI menace. Ideas and concepts from you are welcome, just send them over to us!

Towards a brighter future,

The PhaigeX MegaCorp.

notes.content:
To all the esteemed employees of PhaigeX, we are excited to announce that...
[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/8ef9274440a637e3623c652ade4fdd731b254c37.png[/img][/h3]

[h2]Fleet Assault Game Mode has been Completed![/h2]
This milestone also means that the game mode is finally out of Beta Test. Let's see what the AI fleet has in store for us, and it seems that strength in upgrades alone is not enough to combat their strategically-positioned fleet formations.

A head-on rush will just get you bombarded by the fleet's full firepower, so assess the situation and pick out which units to take out first, and eventually weaken the fleet one step at a time.

On a side note, an option for 8x Warp Calls is now available at the Transportal for employees with excess Warp Cores to spare. Now is a good time to upgrade and customize your ships and take on this new challenge.
[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/e48e1836e9e10713731db9bd6f3c18856176bcbf.jpg[/img][/h3]

Come on and take on the Fleet Assault, and help us collect more combat data. Feedback and suggestions are appreciated, and will contribute towards the development of our next stage in the Roadmap!

Attention all PhaigeX employees. This is a warning for the upcoming threat that's building up.

Sightings from our Recon satellites have found anomalous units that are unknown to our current database. It seems that the rogue AI is starting to evolve and adapt to our efforts in stopping its incursion. Fortunately, we have collected some combat data about them, to be used once an encounter in the future is inevitable. The enemy forces are starting to gather once again, and soon enough... we will need to mount a full-on Fleet Assault and prevent their advance.

notes.content:

Greetings to all PhaigeX employees.

Our busy people here at Development are still hard at work to deliver new content for the workplace. Research and development of new weapons and passives for the powerup pack are still progressing as scheduled. Please look forward to them at a future post, since the people here still need to test them on live battle scenarios.

For now, as part of the Powerup Pack Milestone, here is what we are currently working on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/b6b7e5247b539d211b86e3d1abd24d606b8d6613.jpg[/img]

[h3]CUSTOMIZE: SHIP MODIFIERS[/h3]

Replacing the old "spend Warp Cores to randomize a stat" upgrade, is the [b]Ship Modifiers[/b] system. These equippable modifiers upgrade the ship in a lot of ways. Modifiers (Mods for short) can change as simple as a ship's stats, or as complex as providing bonuses and benefits for playing a certain style.

Each ship has 3 Modifier Slots for the type of benefit it gives:
[list]
[*] [b]Offensive[/b] - bonuses to ship attacks
[*] [b]Defensive[/b] - bonuses to ship protection
[*] [b]Support[/b]- bonuses to either the Player Ship or Support Craft
[/list]
These Mods can be acquired in two ways:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/0389d1cbfd36ea59b435d09f1863985faddf2dcf.jpg[/img]
First, as a result of a [b]Warp Call[/b]. Aside from acquiring dupe stat bonuses, there is also a warp call result that the dupe ship will instead, have a Modifier attached.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/9c31e3e91da7c75847361196f4420b936db97be9.jpg[/img]
Second, as a reward for [b]Ending a Run[/b]. When you finish a run (in a victory or defeat state), there is a chance of this reward screen to appear [b]if you have a lot of unused Requisition Points (RP)[/b]. Choose the one you can afford for the ship that you were piloting.

Once you acquired the Mod, it will be available at the Customize screen to be equipped only for one particular ship (the dupe ship in Warp Call, or the Player Ship used for that run). Mix and match ship modifiers to better suit your own play style!

The Ship Modifier system will be released as a part of the Powerup Pack Milestone. So, together with the new stuff, personalize your own ship, and work your way to victory!

Towards a brighter future,

The PhaigeX MegaCorp.

notes.title: 5/19/2022 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Greetings, PhaigeX employees!

This is a quick announcement for some immediate changes made to address some possible game-breaking issues. We thank you for reporting the issues to the management as soon as it was discovered.

[h2]Workspace Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]Complete Implementation of Mouse-Controlled Sight Line Aiming Mode[/h3]
Using the Mouse in Sight Line aiming mode has now been made simpler. Moving the mouse horizontally to the right rotates the ship clockwise, and counter-clockwise when moved to the left. The mouse sensitivity can also be adjusted to fine-tune the amount of rotation per mouse movement.
[*][h3]Space Background Adjustments[/h3]
The moving space background elements has been toned down a bit, to lessen on-screen distractions while keeping the player's ship alive.
[*][h3]Reworked Transportal[/h3]
Compared to the previous "Duplicate ships has random stats that can be used to overwrite current stats", duplicate ships now provides a customized stat addition (or a small subtraction) to randomly selected ship stats. It's still up to the player to commit those changes to the current stats.
[/list]
[h2]Resolved Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3][Comet Dash] Level 3 steering bug using Mouse Sight Line[/h3]
Together with the complete implementation of the mouse-controlled sight line, the steering controls of the Comet's SP Tech has been made compatible with the new aiming mode.
[*][h3][Fortress Shell] Level 5 effect stays even when armor is destroyed[/h3]
Following the routine maintenance, the buffs brought by Fortress Shell now properly wears off when the armor gets destroyed.
[*][h3][Drone Assault] "Triple Click" Bug[/h3]
A report has been received about pressing the Monarch's SP tech in quick succession can change the drones into a "floating active state" that can be exploitable in dealing contact damage to enemies. The drone units have been sent to Maintenance for repairs.
[*][h3][Afterimage] Critical Bug[/h3]
A game-breaking issue has been reported that stops the game when Mirage's afterimages get hit by enemy fire. This issue had to be dealt with immediately.
[/list]
[h2]Ongoing Plans[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]New Weapon Implementations[/h3]
Rest assured that the plan stated on the roadmap is still in progress. We have some weapon concepts already under development, and will be forwarded to live testing.
[*][h3]Complete Overhaul for Ship Customization[/h3]
The Development Team went back to the drawing board and discussed possible ideas to improve ship customization, other than just for min-maxing stats. For now, keep those notifications enabled for breakthroughs in this field.
[/list]
Rest assured that we are still on track in terms of the roadmap progress. It is inevitable that there are times that we must address the immediate dangers while working towards our goals.

Towards a brighter future,

The PhaigeX MegaCorp.

notes.title: PhaigeX now has Full Controller Support!
notes.content:
Greetings to all the employees of PhaigeX.

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43842456/f7ce13f59b81ccaf5a062a3f939157f19361db83.png[/img][/h3]

Due to insistent public demand, we are pleased to announce that the game now offers full Controller support!

[h2]Full Controller Support[/h2]
PhaigeX requires that the gamepad has twin analog sticks to play properly. The two important ship functions, movement and aiming, are assigned to those analog sticks and cannot be changed.

[h2]Remapping Controls[/h2]
In addition to the new input device, control schemes can now be remapped, whether you are using keyboard+mouse or a gamepad. These can be found in the Options Menu. Remapping is mostly limited to in-game functions. Menus and the like uses set buttons to navigate, and will be labeled besides key UI elements as guides.

[h2]Aiming Modes[/h2]
With new control schemes comes new ways to aim! This is an open experiment to our employees in a pursuit of the best handling experience for the company equipment. Both aiming modes are available in Mouse and Gamepad devices.
[list]
[*][h3]Cursor Reticle[/h3]
This is the default aim mode for the mouse. The gamepad implementation is using the Right Stick to move the cursor around, which does the aiming. This is good for maintaining accurate aim at one spot.
[*][h3]Sight Line[/h3]
This is the default aim mode for the gamepad. Point the Right Stick to the intended direction, and the ship will rotate facing that direction. This is good for quick responses and flexibility.
[/list]
To collect usage data from the new implementations, the PhaigeX demo is now updated as well to include these control additions! Feel free to customize your work experience, and give us some feedback about the controls, as these can still be improved further with future updates.

Towards a brighter future,

The PhaigeX MegaCorp.

notes.title: 4/29/2023 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Greetings to all the employees of PhaigeX, this is a quick announcement of some of the workplace improvements and issues we had to immediately resolve, else the repercussions could become game-breaking.

[h2]Workspace Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]Damage Mitigation for Player Ships using Base Stats[/h3]
After receiving complaints from multiple employees about getting blasted by dense drone swarms, the mechanics have installed a device on all company-standard ships. Getting hit once will trigger the ship to have a "damage buffer", which prevents consecutive ship damage due to multiple damage sources, allowing the ship to live longer. This buffer will only be active on very short time windows to prevent overloading. This feature will not be available for customized ships, so choose your equipment wisely.
[*][h3]Increased the Standard Rotation Speed for All Player Ships[/h3]
Our mechanics also had the time to standardize and improve the rotation speed for all ships. Aiming your weapons at the opposition will now be more efficient.
[*][h3]Incursion Reduction Mechanics Adjusted after the Escape Portal Appears[/h3]
It was observed recently at the enemy side that once the Escape Portal appears, their programming would shift focus on increasing the Incursion Rate without interruption. Destroying Elite enemies would then have a lessened reduction effect during the Escape Phase, until a point is reached that the reduction will not work anymore. Whether you decide to fight or take flight with this newfound behavior, it is your choice.
[/list]
[h2]Resolved Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]Support Shop Hard-Capped Ship Stats Issue[/h3]
It was reported that the Support Shop has been setting a limit to how high a ship stat can be increased. This has been classified as an urgent issue, and was immediately addressed and resolved. In addition, the visibility of the Low HP warning has been improved further.
[/list]
[h2]Ongoing Plans[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]Game Controller Support and Customizable Control Settings[/h3]
Rest assured that this is a current work in progress, and this will be unveiled in a major update once the implementation is completed.
[*][h3]Fleet Assault Game Mode Completion[/h3]
Even though it is playable, the current Fleet Assault game mode is still in a Beta Test state. After the gamepad support update, we will go back and improve on this concept, adding more variety and mechanics to spice up this game mode.
